mintAuthority.summary: Native Ethereum reUSD issuance is held by the collateral-backed InsuranceCapitalLayer; the immutable redemption contract retains a non-callable MINTER_ROLE assignment but has no ShareToken mint call. A two-day TimelockController holds the live UUPS upgrader role, while both it and a 3-of-5 Safe hold token DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; the Safe can immediately authorize new native minters or upgraders. Chainlink CCIP pool authority is reviewed separately under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: reUSD InsuranceCapitalLayer MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.capDescription: The verified InsuranceCapitalLayer mints reUSD shares only after supported collateral is transferred in and share conversion checks pass. Its own UUPS upgrader role is held by the same two-day timelock that controls reUSD.
controls.evidence: The complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history plus hasRole() at Ethereum block 25712112 confirms this proxy still holds reUSD MINTER_ROLE. Verified InsuranceCapitalLayer source calls shareToken.mint() only in collateral-backed deposit flows; its live UPGRADER_ROLE is held by timelock 0x69ddea332723cf5407151aaf68b9b076557fca93.

controls.label: reUSD InstantRedemption MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) was true at Ethereum block 25712112, but the verified immutable InstantRedemption bytecode exposes redemption and burn flows and contains no call to ShareToken.mint(). The role assignment therefore is not a live callable mint surface in this implementation.

controls.label: reUSD token admin and UUPS upgrader timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, this TimelockController remained a reUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder and the sole current UPGRADER_ROLE holder; getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. The governance Safe is a second DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder, so the delay does not bound the Safe's ability to grant a new upgrader. Verified ShareToken source gates minting by MINTER_ROLE and UUPS replacement by UPGRADER_ROLE.

controls.label: reUSD governance Safe (token DEFAULT_ADMIN)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, Safe calls returned threshold 3 and five owners; Safe Transaction Service reported version 1.4.1, no modules, and zero guard. hasRole() also confirmed the Safe directly holds token DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, so it can immediately grant MINTER_ROLE or UPGRADER_ROLE. It remains the sole TimelockController proposer, executor, and canceller.

review.evidence: A complete Blockscout RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay through Ethereum block 25712112, followed by direct hasRole() checks, found the live native InsuranceCapitalLayer MINTER_ROLE holder, the non-calling InstantRedemption role assignment, two DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders, and one current UPGRADER_ROLE holder. The Ethereum CCIP pool is excluded from this native set because its MINTER_ROLE is exercised only through validated cross-chain releaseOrMint machinery and is recorded under Bridge Risk. Both timelock 0x69ddea332723cf5407151aaf68b9b076557fca93 and Safe 0x8eec10616802ef639ca55c98ac856553fadefbad hold DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Although the timelock's current upgrade actions wait 172800 seconds, the 3-of-5 Safe can immediately grant itself or another address native MINTER_ROLE or UPGRADER_ROLE. Verified implementations establish the native minter's collateral-backed callable behavior and the redemption contract's absence of a ShareToken mint call. The Network Firm attests the off-chain Regulation-114 trust/reinsurance balances daily and publishes the result to a live Chainlink proof-of-reserve feed, so supply is continuously reconciled. The reinsurer Cover Re SPC is CIMA-licensed, but the reUSD token issuer itself is an unregulated foundation, so supervision remains attestation-only. The native permissioned minter's encoding-derived cap does not bound issuance against reserves, so economic cap semantics remain unbounded.
